Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
2026-05-24
DOC-0029
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-05-24
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0019, TEAM-0001
Subject: Trial of Keeper and Origin Tabs for Duplicate Notes
Decision: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA will trial keeper and origin tabs on
duplicate-merge paperwork from 2026-05-25 through 2026-06-12. The trial
evaluates whether a later reader can reconstruct why papers were combined
and where each original question came from.
Both issue IDs must remain on the cover sheet. The keeper tab holds the
rationale for selecting the continuing entry and the next administrative action.
The origin tab holds the received questions and the references that led to the
comparison. Similar titles alone are not grounds for combining papers.
If the originating desks disagree about scope, the queue chair records the
disagreement and names the role that will resolve it. Keep the papers
separately identifiable during that discussion. Do not make a new record
reference merely to fill the trial layout.
The avionics folder located by DEMO-AIR-0009 and ISSUE-0151 supplies a
layout example. TASK-0398, TASK-0399, and TASK-0400 may locate attached
discussion papers; this memo does not identify a duplicate partner.
Implementation: PERSON-0019 will brief the filing clerk on 2026-05-25. At the
trial review, the clerk will bring examples of unclear lineage labels and the
chair will decide which tab instructions to retain. Document that decision on
the trial cover sheet for later policy drafting.
ok
D. Worker 0017
Demo Worker 0019, Demo Team 01
